lines: The app declares Nextcloud 32 as its lowest server, and the lowest server image is 33: the end-of-life majors below it are not installed.
Nextcloud 33.0.11 on PHP 8.5.13: the app needs the app of OCA\OpenRegister, which the test server does not have, and info.xml has no way to name it.
OCA\OpenRegister: the app openregister of the App Store has no release for this server.
What it causes is not reported on its own:
install-log-errors: the server logs 1 entry of level 3 or higher that names the app.
